title: Friday & Saturday Shuttle Service
summary: Park at the Altoona Curve Baseball Stadium Parking Garage and ride to the Blair County Convention Center. Friday and Saturday only.

content.text: Friday & Saturday only. No Sunday shuttle service. All times Eastern.
Where to Park & Catch the Shuttle
Altoona Curve Baseball Stadium Parking Garage

If convention center parking is full, go directly to the Altoona Curve parking garage and board the shuttle to the Blair County Convention Center entrance. Use the banner below to identify the garage and pickup location.
Allow extra time for parking and the ride, especially before a scheduled photo op or panel.
Shuttle service sponsored by First Frontier, Blair County, PA.
